description: Adds a datum tag (IModelDoc2.InsertDatumTag2) to a model entity a view shows, an edge (a face seen edge on) or a face, selected through its view (attach_to, a ViewEntity), never picked by sheet coordinates (SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP4 no longer finds a drawing edge by sheet coordinates for a datum tag). label is 1 to 3 letters A to Z without I, O and Q, and must not already label a datum tag of the drawing; at (sheet mm) moves the tag. Checked: the tag reads back its label, is attached to that entity, and is at at within 0.01 mm when given; the model is unchanged. An entity the view does not show is refused naming the view and the entity. Otherwise the tag is deleted again (rolled back).

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

label.description: The datum's label: 1 to 3 letters A to Z without I, O and Q (A, B, AA).

view.description: The view: a reference (r1.view.…) or its name (Drawing View1).

reference.description: A reference issued in the view's model (model.find, view.entities), alone. One of reference or entity.

component.description: With entity in an assembly view: the component, by reference or name; entity is then a reference issued in the component's own part, or a name there.

entity.description: A name in the view's model (Boss-Extrude1, front, Axis1@pin-1), or with component an entity of that component. One of reference or entity.

attach_to.description: The edge or face the tag is attached to, as a view shows it.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where the tag goes, sheet mm. Where SOLIDWORKS puts it when absent.
